avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: P-gp and OATP inducer; reduces pibrentasvir concentrations via increased efflux and decreased hepatic uptake
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may reduce antiviral efficacy

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent P-gp/OATP inducer; significantly decreases pibrentasvir bioavailability

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential P-gp inhibition may increase pibrentasvir levels slightly
caution_supplements.action: Monitor; generally acceptable but use consistent intake

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (>600 kcal fat)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly increases pibrentasvir absorption and exposure; may increase adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Take on empty stomach or with low-fat meal; standardize timing relative to food

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential minor P-gp inhibition; clinical significance unclear with pibrentasvir
caution_foods.action: Minimize intake or maintain consistent consumption patterns

monitoring_notes: Pibrentasvir has minimal hepatic metabolism but is a substrate for P-gp and OATP transporters; monitor for reduced efficacy with inducing supplements or foods that significantly alter absorption. Ensure consistent meal-timing practices to maintain stable drug levels.
